content:
Apple announced today that it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13), with the tagline "Welcome Home".

Apple will introduce a brand-new Home product lineup on October 13, with Greg Joswiak dropping the first hint

Apple will unveil new products next Tuesday (October 13), as teased in a video posted by Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak. Below is the video uploaded by Joswiak.

Apple is expected to launch several new Home products at the event, including:

Additionally, the LG smart home accessories that surfaced earlier are also expected to make their debut next week; according to reports, these accessories were co-developed by Apple and LG.

Along with Joswiak's date announcement, Apple has also sent invitations to the media to attend a special "Apple Experience" event at 9:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) held at Tribeca, New York.

Below is the invitation showcased by Marques Brownlee:

Top comment from JP

Three products. I'm guessing three colours of the  Car: Space Grey, White, and another slightly different shade of White.

Earlier this year, when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it hosted a similar "Apple Experience" event for the media. That product launch was also held following days of press releases.

However, current expectations are that all of Apple's new Home products will be unveiled on the same day.

It remains uncertain whether Apple will simultaneously release a full video introducing the new products at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day; we will continue to provide updates as more details become available.

Which new Apple products are you looking forward to seeing on October 13? Let us know in the comments.
